deviations.what: The 'Toggle Busy State' button sets a boolean model field bound to Panel1.busy and the Icon.busy (both added to carry the binding; the original set busy imperatively via byId().setBusy). The 5s auto-reset of the original setTimeout is reproduced with START_TIMER, which fires a CLEAR_BUSY round trip that clears the same field. **e2e-verified 2026-07-30** (transpiled-framework interaction, scripts/e2e-smoke.mjs): the button round-trip turns the bound controls busy (sapUiLocalBusy present after the click).
